basic_details.job_title: Cochin Port Authority Executive Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Update 16 Nov 2026: Last date to apply is now 30 December 2026. Cochin Port Authority re-issued the circular on 16-11-2026 for officers of Major Ports, who must apply through proper channel with the listed documents.

qualification.education_qualification: Degree in Electrical/Electronics and Communication Engineering
qualification.details: Degree or equivalent in Electrical/Electronics and Communication Engineering from a recognised university/Institution with five years experience in relevant discipline in executive cadre in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. undertaking. Applications are invited from officers of Major Port Authorities who hold analogous posts in the Electrical/Electronics and Communication Engineering discipline, or who hold the feeder post with 5 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port. 30.12.2026 is the crucial date for deciding qualification and experience.

salary_details.details: Rs. 50000 - 160000 Per Month (pre-revised Rs. 10750-16750), in the Mechanical Engineering Department

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Cochin Port Authority Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.cochinport.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.

Send the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-II) through proper channel. Enclose attested copies of educational and professional qualifications, attested ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, the No-Objection Certificate of the respective Port, two recent passport size colour photographs in a sealed envelope, and an undertaking not to withdraw candidature if selected. Also enclose the Head of Office certificate (Annexure-III), the vigilance/administrative clearance (Annexure-IV), the order declaring satisfactory completion of probation in the feeder post, and details of unauthorised absence/EOL (or a Nil Certificate).

Applications received late, without ACRs/APARs or otherwise incomplete will not be considered. An advance copy will not be considered if the application through proper channel does not reach within 15 days of the last date.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-12-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Cochin Port Authority Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) post is 30th December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) position at Cochin Port Authority.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree in Electrical/Electronics and Communication Engineering from a recognized university or institution, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Executive Engineer (Ele/E&C) role?
faq.answer: The salary for this post ranges from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply through the offline mode by sending their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Cochin Port Authority.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is No.A4/EE(Ele/E&C)/2026/S.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on Absorption/Deputation.
